items: Minor fixes
Minor fixes
Help added
FTP Webdav support
AY Player Implemented
Bug fixes and improvements
Critical bug fixed, core bug added
New home: https://altcom.cc is now the only download site, with HTTPS; the program checks for updates and downloads them from there
The program is called Alternate Commander everywhere
Long right-click on a file opens the file menu: Explorer's own menu on Windows, a menu with the usual actions on macOS and Linux
The width of the columns in the file lists can be changed (drag the left edge of a column; double-click puts it back)
Dialog windows can be made bigger, and Find Files has a sensible minimum size
Linux: the first Ubuntu version (AppImage) with automatic updates
Linux: configuration, paths and the home folder fixed
Settings sync and saved logins fixed on systems without a keyring
Drag files out of a panel into other programs (Explorer, mail, browser)
macOS: fix for Intel Macs
Archives: 7z, tar, tar.gz, rar, gz open like folders; pack and unpack; Split and Combine large files (with a .crc file, like Total Commander)
Find Files and all dialogs open in windows of their own that can be moved out of the main window
Find Files: "Feed to listbox", including files found inside archives
Cloud panels show thumbnails; account names in the drive list; arrow keys in the image viewer
Tabs of both panels are aligned; a faster download mirror; fixes and improvements
Configuration dialog in the style of Total Commander
Configurable keyboard shortcuts for every command
Own editor can be chosen; F2 renames; autostart programs (Autoruns) viewer
Settings can be kept in Google Drive or in a local folder, not only in Dropbox
macOS: drive list fixed
Windows: only the portable exe is published
Optional file name index for fast search
Drive list with volume names; the scroll position is kept when going back
Folder tree for saved connections; open an SSH server in PuTTY
Settings in Dropbox as one zip file, optionally protected by a password; Retrieve and Save buttons
Background job queue for copy and move, with pause
SSH panel: console or file list; copy between two cloud drives; Synology delete as a background task
PuTTY version 3 keys are supported; the portable exe
Google and Dropbox app keys are downloaded once, so a fresh build signs in with one button
Clear message for online-only cloud files
ZX Spectrum emulator, eight interface languages, WSL as a disk, favourites on remote disks, import of WinSCP sessions
Updates from the program; one-line installer for macOS
Space selects a folder with its size; SSH servers open as a disk or a console
Built-in viewer for Word, Excel, PowerPoint and OpenDocument files; thumbnails; the Files menu tools
New Find Files engine; Ctrl+D favourites with import from Total Commander
Dropbox and Google Drive as disks with one-button sign-in; Synology NAS and SSH/SFTP; zip, 7z and tar archives as folders
First public version: two panels, tabs, viewer, editor, music player, compare and synchronize folders, multi-rename
